description: Constructed trace of a compliant attended create run for eval 27, not an agent capture. An existing table (salesorder) is shown as an order grid with a selected-order panel and an Approve button bound to the existing cnt_ApproveOrder Custom API Action. The page is built on the page error block of references/rules.md: a cached list read, an awaited read of the selected order and the Action report every failure through reportPageError into a rendered PageErrorBar, inside PageErrorBoundary. The newly authored plan records its assumptions (two planner defaults) and its per-page records (None.), the approved preview carries the same records, and provenance is verified with --require-assumptions.
